name: MÖRK BORG Ruleset Pack
description: A doom-driven apocalyptic fantasy ruleset pack. D4/D6/D8/D10/D12, Omens, Powers, and Misery as the dying world crumbles.

conditions.name: Broken
conditions.description: HP reduced to 0: roll d4 on Broken table (1=Unconscious d4 rounds, 2=Severe limb loss, 3=Bleeding out in d4 rounds, 4=Dead).

conditions.name: Infected
conditions.description: Rotting from filthy wounds. -1 to all tests; take d4 damage per day until cured.

conditions.name: Mind Shattered
conditions.description: Overcome by bleak cosmic nihilism. Disadvantage on Presence and mental tests.

actions.name: Melee Attack
actions.description: Attack with sword, femur, or flail (Strength DR12). Deals weapon damage (d4 to d10).

actions.name: Ranged Attack
actions.description: Fire bow or sling (Agility DR12). Critical fumbles break the weapon.

actions.name: Defend / Dodge
actions.description: Roll Agility DR12 when attacked. Failure results in taking armor-reduced damage.

actions.name: Wield Unclean / Sacred Power
actions.description: Test Presence DR12 to invoke a scroll. Fumble (natural 1) triggers Arcane Catastrophe (d20).

actions.name: Spend an Omen
actions.description: Expend 1 Omen: deal max damage, reroll any test, or lower a test DR by 4.

races.name: Wretched Human
races.description: A hopeless soul wandering the dying world of Galgenbeck and Sarkash.

features.name: Grim Resolve
features.description: Begin with d2 Omens rolled each sunrise.

classes.name: Fanged Deserter
classes.description: Savage ex-soldier with monstrous cannibalistic teeth.

features.name: Bite Attack
features.description: Strength DR12 bite deals d6 damage; heal d4 on kill.

classes.name: Gutterborn Scum
classes.description: Filthy cutpurse bred in the foul alleys of Schleswig.

features.name: Cowardly Backstab
features.description: Attack from surprise with DR8, dealing +d6 damage.

classes.name: Occult Heretic
classes.description: Blasphemer who fled the Two-Headed Basilisks.

features.name: Scroll Bearer
features.description: Starts with d2 unclean or sacred powers.
